dialogues.speaker: Kofitse
dialogues.text: I am Kofitse of Mict{RUBY#[D]Masters of the Night-Wind}lan, and I walk as a supplicant of the Wayob. It is they who have sent me to show the outlander warriors of Nephil{RUBY#[D]Nod-Krai}heim the way.

dialogues.speaker: Kofitse
dialogues.text: Yet the guard named Levonty referred to me as a traveling merchant and ordered me to "conduct my business" here.

dialogues.speaker: Kofitse
dialogues.text: But surely, words of wisdom cannot be spoken to the foolish? No matter — the night wind will eventually make them know the secret truths I impart... the truths revealed by the Wayob in ages past.
